from.place: Proof paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction and coherent tower realization, through the pointed-model stability foundation and the finite pushout grid in lem-coef-suspension-square-comparison: the underlying fiber-cone assembly used to construct a finite-poset extension, before proving its unit or its Kan universal property. Local relative extension over one positive-dimensional simplex, with the boundary already fixed, in the skeletal assembly proof. Prerequisite: A colimit cocone is initial relative to restriction of its base.

title: A colimit cocone is initial relative to restriction of its base
statement:
Use coherent diagrams, transformations, mapping spaces and colimiting cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set and $\mathcal E$ a quasicategory in a containing universe. Define the right join cone $K^{\triangleright}=K\star\Delta^0$: its simplices are those of either factor and the ordered concatenations of a simplex of $K$ with a simplex at the new final vertex. Write
$$r:\operatorname{Fun}(K^{\triangleright},\mathcal E)\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal E)$$
for restriction. Let $c:K^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal E$ be a simplicial map. Its induced coherent cocone is obtained by precomposition with $K\times\Delta^1\to K^{\triangleright}$, splitting each interval simplex at its change from $0$ to $1$, retaining its initial $K$-vertices and sending its final vertices to the cone vertex. If that coherent cocone is colimiting, then for every simplicial map $t:K^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal E$, restriction induces a weak homotopy equivalence of Kan complexes
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K^{\triangleright},\mathcal E)}(c,t)\ \longrightarrow\ \operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal E)}(c|_K,t|_K).$$
The base diagram of $t$ is arbitrary, and need not equal $c|_K$.

source.place: Proposition 7.1.6.13, colimit dual with target base a point: the cone is initial relative to restriction. The join-to-coherent-cocone convention is the opposite dual of the fixed-boundary comparison in lem-coef-infinity-join-cone-calculus (Kerodon 4.6.6.8). Read online; not archived.
